result.title: CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
result.comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Published in International Journal of Computer Vision
result.summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation aims to classify pixels without being restricted to a fixed set of categories. Although Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) demonstrates remarkable potential for open-vocabulary recognition, its segmentation capability is impaired by noisy inter-class patch interactions. To this end, this work proposes a unified training-free object-centric framework, named CorrCLIPv2, from three complementary aspects of patch correlation, feature representation, and output regularization. Specifically, for patch correlation, we leverage class-agnostic mask generators to explicitly disentangle inter-class interactions. Moreover, we utilize spatially-coherent features from self-supervised models to compute attention scores to mitigate mask inaccuracies. Regarding feature representation, we devise a refinement mechanism to simultaneously strengthen spatial details and semantic representation. Within the output space, we unify predictions via voting in each mask to enhance spatial consistency. To mitigate contextual bias and enhance prediction accuracy of objects, we further extend the framework by incorporating a cross-image object retrieval paradigm, which incurs minimal computational overhead. We build a memory bank of CorrCLIP-enhanced features from unlabeled images and implement a regime of multi-CLIP ensemble. By aggregating semantically consistent object features across diverse contexts retrieved from the memory bank, CorrCLIPv2 mitigates context-induced interference and obtains more robust predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art on 10 standard benchmarks. Remarkably, it even surpasses fully supervised open-vocabulary methods across 22 multi-domain datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/zdk258/CorrCLIP.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的开放词表语义分割框架 CorrCLIPv2：用类别无关掩码显式解耦 patch 间交互，借助自监督模型的空间一致特征修正掩码，加入同时强化空间细节与语义的特征细化，并在掩码内投票统一输出；进一步用无标注图像构建记忆库做跨图像目标检索与多 CLIP 集成以缓解上下文偏差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其基于掩码的区域级特征聚合与跨图像检索式记忆库，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、上下文干扰抑制及特征状态更新提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理轨迹的生成或使用。
